firstPlayerRule: Everyone chooses a card at the same time, then reveals and plays it together. There is no single starting player in normal play.
officialTieBreak: Not applicable: players choose and play simultaneously.
clarifications: For a first learning game, the rulebook recommends playing cards one at a time to explain their effects. It does not name a starting player for that teaching suggestion.
This entry covers the multiplayer base game, not 7 Wonders Duel.
